headlines.title: After Selling Poppi For $1.95B, The Ellsworths Are Back With Another Startup. But What Comes After A Billion-Dollar Exit?
headlines.summary: Just 18 months after selling their soda company for nearly $2 billion, the founders are back with another beverage brand, this time hoping to shake up the $13 billion hydration market.

headlines.title: BIG3 Names Veteran PepsiCo Sports Executive Adam Harter President of Business Operations
headlines.summary: LOS ANGELES, November 12, 2026--The BIG3, the premier global 3-on-3 professional basketball league, today announced the appointment of Adam Harter as President of Business Operations of BIG3 Basketball, LLC. Effective immediately, Harter, who spent more than two decades leading sports and entertainment marketing at PepsiCo, will report directly to BIG3 co-founders Ice Cube, the league’s CEO, and Chairman Jeff Kwatinetz.

headlines.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Plans 1,000 North America Job Cuts In Elliott Backed Turnaround
headlines.summary: PepsiCo (NasdaqGS:PEP) plans to cut about 1,000 jobs across its North American units as part of a turnaround effort. The layoffs follow pressure from activist investor Elliott Investment Management, which has been pushing for sharper cost and productivity measures. Management is tying the workforce reduction to efforts to address sluggish North American sales and to refocus operations on efficiency.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
